verdict.rationale: Vast.ai's docs describe templates that set up a rented machine with whatever software you need. They also cover building a template that packages your environment, launching custom templates with one click, and configuring any Docker image's run options and entrypoint from the GUI or CLI. A community comment corroborates that renters can deploy images. missing for 10: explicit documentation of pulling your own image from a public or private registry, and in-depth hands-on corroboration of running a fully custom image.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run my own Docker image or custom machine template with my exact environment

citations.quote: A template is how Vast helps you launch an instance, setting up your rented machine with whatever software and formatting you need.
Build a template - Package your environment so any GPU can run it with one click.
Launch prebuilt or custom templates with one click.
You can open custom ports for any docker image using -p arguments in the docker create/run options box in the image config editor pop-up menu.
The docker image entrypoint is the main run process, which you can override in the GUI or CLI (--entrypoint).
